controls.name: depolarizing_noise

applicability.statement: The depolarizing error is equally distributed among all modes, the input probabilities are equal, and the storage efficiencies are identical across modes.
The fixed memory supports 11 spatial modes.

readouts.definition: Information capacity C_qm of the quantum memory channel for transmitting photonic qudits.
readouts.name: channel_capacity

source.citation: Hao-Xuan Luo, High-Performance Quantum Memory for Quantum Interconnects, Physical Review Letters (2026), DOI:10.1103/k35f-7k9s

assessment: Eligible. The source reports an 11-mode memory, explicitly defines depolarizing noise and evaluates the model at 1%, 10%, and 50%, and gives the closed channel-capacity expression under equal input probabilities, equal storage efficiencies, and uniformly distributed crosstalk. The card reproduces that expression with base-2 logarithms, uses a genuinely variable model noise probability, preserves the one-dimensional reported domain, and yields a deterministic capacity in bits under the stated assumptions.
